notes: Global-fit / phenomenology paper (Giannotti, Irastorza, Redondo, Ringwald, Saikawa 2017). It interprets stellar cooling anomalies (WD variables, WDLF, RGB tip, R-parameter/HB, NS in Cas A) as axion hints and derives best-fit / favored (2-sigma) regions in axion couplings (g_ae, g_agamma, g_an, g_ap) for DFSZ and KSVZ axion/majoron models (Tables 4-7, Figs 1-4). These are FAVORED/hinted regions from a fit, not an observational exclusion limit: e.g. g_ae = 1.6e-13 (eq 2.4) is a best-fit central value. The nucleon SN 1987A bound and NS (g_an^2 ~ 1.4e-19) inputs are taken from other references, not newly derived. Future-experiment curves (IAXO, IAXO+, ARIADNE) shown in Figs are projections. Therefore no new measured exclusion limit to report; not primarily a projection paper either (headline result is the cooling-anomaly interpretation/hint).
